- Initial release of Meituan Travel Assistant.
- Provides one-stop search for hotels, flights, train tickets, attraction tickets, and itinerary planning.
- Covers data for 300+ cities across China.
- Simple setup—no configuration required.
- Supports queries in natural language with city and request parameters.
- Includes examples and integration suggestions for travel planning workflows.
